label: TP
reason: The parameter 'param' is derived from user input via getParameterNames() and getParameterValues(), and is directly used as a format string in response.getWriter().format(). This constitutes a cross-site scripting vulnerability because an attacker can inject malicious content into the format string which will be executed when the page is rendered.

evidence.note: User input is retrieved via getParameterNames() and getParameterValues(), which are sources of tainted data
The variable 'bar' (which contains user-controlled data) is used as a format string in response.getWriter().format()
